list.name: service_filter
list.label: Service filter (L1)
list.description: Limit the recent-traces list to traces that touched this exact service name. Empty = all.

list.name: trace_search
list.label: Trace search (L1)
list.description: ILIKE on the originating span:instance:online event_message (the entry-point service name or root span name).

list.name: selected_trace
list.label: Selected trace
list.description: Root span_id of the selected trace. Set by clicking a row in the L1 table. Witness has no trace_id — a trace is the connected component walked from this span. Clear to hide the L2/L3 panels.

list.name: selected_service
list.label: Selected service
list.description: Set automatically by clicking a service in the L2 node graph or per-service bar chart. Clear to view logs of all services in the trace.

list.name: selected_span
list.label: Selected span
list.description: Set automatically by clicking a span row in the L2 spans table. Overrides the service filter — L3 shows only events whose span chain contains this span_id. Clear to fall back to (trace, service) scoping.

panels.title: Recent traces — click a row to drill into L2/L3

targets.rawSql: WITH RECURSIVE roots AS (SELECT tr.root_span_id, tr.span_name, tr.service_name, tr.started_at, tr.duration FROM witness.trace_roots tr WHERE tr.started_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp AND tr.started_at <= $__timeTo()::timestamp AND ('$service_filter' = '' OR tr.service_name = '$service_filter') AND ('$trace_search' = '' OR tr.span_name ILIKE '%' || '$trace_search' || '%') ORDER BY tr.started_at DESC LIMIT 500), trace_edges AS (SELECT parent_span_id AS from_id, child_span_id AS to_id FROM witness.span_children UNION ALL SELECT from_span_id, to_span_id FROM witness.link_edges), trace_spans AS (SELECT r.root_span_id AS root, r.root_span_id AS span_id FROM roots r UNION SELECT ts.root, te.to_id FROM trace_edges te JOIN trace_spans ts ON ts.span_id = te.from_id) SELECT r.root_span_id::text AS root_span_id, r.span_name AS name, COALESCE(r.service_name, '') AS service, r.started_at, ROUND((EXTRACT(epoch FROM r.duration) * 1000)::numeric, 2) AS duration_ms, count(*)::bigint AS event_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type IN (13, 14, 100, 101, 102, 103, 104))::bigint AS error_count, COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT ei.service_name, ', '), '') AS services FROM roots r JOIN trace_spans ts ON ts.root = r.root_span_id JOIN witness.spans s ON s.span_id = ts.span_id AND s.span_flags & 1 <> 0 JOIN witness.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id LEFT JOIN witness.event_instances ei ON ei.event_id = e.event_id GROUP BY r.root_span_id, r.span_name, r.service_name, r.started_at, r.duration ORDER BY r.started_at DESC

WITH RECURSIVE trace_edges AS (SELECT parent_span_id AS from_id, child_span_id AS to_id FROM witness.span_children UNION ALL SELECT from_span_id, to_span_id FROM witness.link_edges), trace_spans AS (SELECT (CASE WHEN '${selected_trace}' = '' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' ELSE '${selected_trace}' END)::uuid AS span_id UNION SELECT te.to_id FROM trace_edges te JOIN trace_spans ts ON ts.span_id = te.from_id), trace_events AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.event_type, e.event_date, ei.service_name FROM trace_spans ts JOIN witness.spans s ON s.span_id = ts.span_id AND s.span_flags & 1 <> 0 JOIN witness.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id LEFT JOIN witness.event_instances ei ON ei.event_id = e.event_id) SELECT COALESCE(service_name, '<unknown>') AS id, COALESCE(service_name, '<unknown>') AS title, 'service' AS "subTitle", count(*)::float8 AS "mainStat", (CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type IN (13, 14, 100, 101, 102, 103, 104)) > 0 THEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type IN (13, 14, 100, 101, 102, 103, 104))::text || ' errors' ELSE ROUND((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (max(event_date) - min(event_date))) * 1000)::numeric, 1)::text || ' ms span' END) AS "secondaryStat" FROM trace_events GROUP BY service_name UNION ALL SELECT '— select trace —' AS id, 'click a row in L1' AS title, '' AS "subTitle", 0::float8 AS "mainStat", '' AS "secondaryStat" WHERE '${selected_trace}' = ''

WITH RECURSIVE trace_edges AS (SELECT parent_span_id AS from_id, child_span_id AS to_id FROM witness.span_children UNION ALL SELECT from_span_id, to_span_id FROM witness.link_edges), trace_spans AS (SELECT (CASE WHEN '${selected_trace}' = '' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' ELSE '${selected_trace}' END)::uuid AS span_id UNION SELECT te.to_id FROM trace_edges te JOIN trace_spans ts ON ts.span_id = te.from_id) SELECT (le.from_service_name || '->' || le.to_service_name) AS id, le.from_service_name AS source, le.to_service_name AS target, count(*)::float8 AS "mainStat" FROM witness.link_edges le WHERE le.from_span_id IN (SELECT span_id FROM trace_spans) AND le.from_service_name IS NOT NULL AND le.to_service_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY le.from_service_name, le.to_service_name UNION ALL SELECT 'placeholder'::text AS id, ''::text AS source, ''::text AS target, 0::float8 AS "mainStat" WHERE FALSE

targets.rawSql: WITH RECURSIVE trace_edges AS (SELECT parent_span_id AS from_id, child_span_id AS to_id FROM witness.span_children UNION ALL SELECT from_span_id, to_span_id FROM witness.link_edges), trace_spans AS (SELECT (CASE WHEN '${selected_trace}' = '' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' ELSE '${selected_trace}' END)::uuid AS span_id UNION SELECT te.to_id FROM trace_edges te JOIN trace_spans ts ON ts.span_id = te.from_id) SELECT COALESCE(ei.service_name, '<unknown>') AS service_name, count(*)::bigint AS events, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type IN (13, 14, 100, 101, 102, 103, 104))::bigint AS errors FROM trace_spans ts JOIN witness.spans s ON s.span_id = ts.span_id AND s.span_flags & 1 <> 0 JOIN witness.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id LEFT JOIN witness.event_instances ei ON ei.event_id = e.event_id GROUP BY ei.service_name ORDER BY min(e.event_date) ASC

targets.rawSql: WITH RECURSIVE trace_edges AS (SELECT parent_span_id AS from_id, child_span_id AS to_id FROM witness.span_children UNION ALL SELECT from_span_id, to_span_id FROM witness.link_edges), trace_spans AS (SELECT (CASE WHEN '${selected_trace}' = '' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' ELSE '${selected_trace}' END)::uuid AS span_id UNION SELECT te.to_id FROM trace_edges te JOIN trace_spans ts ON ts.span_id = te.from_id) SELECT sp.span_name, sp.service_name, sp.started_at, ROUND((EXTRACT(epoch FROM sp.duration) * 1000)::numeric, 2) AS duration_ms, sc.parent_span_id::text AS parent_span_id, sp.span_id::text AS span_id, sp.start_caller AS caller FROM witness.span_pairs sp LEFT JOIN witness.span_children sc ON sc.child_span_id = sp.span_id WHERE sp.span_id IN (SELECT span_id FROM trace_spans) ORDER BY sp.started_at ASC LIMIT 500

WITH RECURSIVE trace_edges AS (SELECT parent_span_id AS from_id, child_span_id AS to_id FROM witness.span_children UNION ALL SELECT from_span_id, to_span_id FROM witness.link_edges), trace_spans AS (SELECT (CASE WHEN '${selected_trace}' = '' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' ELSE '${selected_trace}' END)::uuid AS span_id UNION SELECT te.to_id FROM trace_edges te JOIN trace_spans ts ON ts.span_id = te.from_id) SELECT (e.event_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS time, e.event_message AS body, COALESCE(etn.event_type_name, e.event_type::text) AS level, COALESCE(ei.service_name, '<unknown>') AS service, COALESCE(ss.span_name, '') AS span, e.event_caller AS caller, e.event_id::text AS id, own.span_id::text AS span_id, COALESCE(erj.records::text, '{}') AS labels FROM witness.events e JOIN witness.spans own ON own.event_id = e.event_id AND own.span_flags & 1 <> 0 LEFT JOIN witness.event_type_names etn ON etn.event_type = e.event_type LEFT JOIN witness.event_records_json erj ON erj.event_id = e.event_id LEFT JOIN witness.event_instances ei ON ei.event_id = e.event_id LEFT JOIN witness.span_starts ss ON ss.span_id = own.span_id WHERE own.span_id IN (SELECT span_id FROM trace_spans) AND own.span_id = COALESCE(nullif('${selected_span}', '')::uuid, own.span_id) AND ('${selected_span}' != '' OR '${selected_service}' = '' OR ei.service_name = '${selected_service}') ORDER BY e.event_date ASC LIMIT 2000
